// Build system prompt + user message for OpenRouter LLM call
const body = $input.item.json.body || $input.item.json;
const query = (body.query || body.message || body.question || '').trim();
const lang = (body.lang || 'fr').toLowerCase();

if (!query || query.length < 2) {
  return {
    json: {
      error: true,
      status: 'ERROR',
      response: lang === 'fr'
        ? 'Veuillez poser une question (champ "query" requis, minimum 2 caracteres).'
        : 'Please provide a question (field "query" required, minimum 2 characters).',
      engine: 'PROJECT_CHATBOT_LLM',
      timestamp: new Date().toISOString()
    }
  };
}
